completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The engine suffered a catastrophic failure due to oil starvation, which caused a total loss of engine power at night over mountainous terrain. [20220915105942:probable_cause] The Nos. 3, 4, 5, and 6 connecting rods likely failed as a result of oil starvation, and the connecting rod journals were blackened, scored, melted, and missing base metal. [20220915105942:analysis][20220915105942:factual] About 1 quart of oil remained in the sump, and the crankshaft could not be rotated by hand. [20220915105942:factual] The investigation could not determine why the oil starvation or loss occurred because of fire and impact damage. [20220915105942:analysis]"}
